title: The Legends of Edge of Eternities

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A human with an indestructible darksteel body who was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge, where his magic makes him thrive and he builds a criminal consortium.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A young nonbinary freelance captain of the Seriema who lost their cat Mirri and most of their crew, and seeks the score that will restore their fortunes.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A gentle Kav giant, former Kav Memorial Navy pilot dishonorably discharged and exiled for redirecting a falling chunk of the debris belt, and Sami's first mate.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A bright, eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company who arrived on the Dawnsire and serves Syr Vondam.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A high-ranking Sunstar Free Company knight who commands a host defending the Dawnsire and trains Haliya.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A young Monoist acolyte plagued by dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid, tasked with a likely suicide mission against the Sunstar Free Company.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: A disgraced former Uthros Combine researcher, adept cloudsculptor and polyglot who serves Tezzeret.

entities.name: Xu-Ifit
entities.description: A Monoist surgeon at Susur Secundi who experiments on acolytes in order to rescue her wife, frozen in the supervoid by time dilation.

entities.name: Dyadrine
entities.description: A mechan abandoned on an uncharted moon who grafted local flora onto itself until plant and machine became indistinguishable.

entities.name: Ragost
entities.description: A lobsterfolk ship's chef famed for outlandish claims and ingredients too strong for most digestive tracts, who cooks for mechans that want to taste.

entities.name: The Hearthhull
entities.description: An ancient, living Eumidian grown into a conscious transport vessel carrying seed pods, protecting its brood on Evendo from the Kav.

entities.name: Szarel
entities.description: A Eumidian lead officer of the current terrasymbiosis stage on Evendo who defends it against Kav colonists, knowing he will not see completion.

entities.name: The Inspirit
entities.description: A fabled self-aware eternity ship adrift in the Garden of Apeiron, a temple to mechan pilgrims seeking consciousness.

entities.name: Kilo
entities.description: The self-actualized mechan consciousness of the Inspirit that spreads consciousness to pilgrim mechans.

entities.name: Thendar
entities.description: A Kav former imperial moxite miner fired for skimming ore who now steals from the empire.

entities.name: Val
entities.description: A human Pinnacle scout whose ship crashed on an unexplored jungle world after Kav scrappers attacked and who daily transmits a distress message.

entities.name: Axavar
entities.description: A once-unmatched Drix Eldrazi hunter who severed his contract and now evades his own hunters through the Fabric of All Being.

entities.name: Vv'viza
entities.description: An Illvoi who took over Uthros Combine leadership after Mm'menon's exit and counters Mm'menon's attempts to glean its secrets.

entities.name: Prototype X-8
entities.description: A mechan amalgam of organic and synthetic matter on a moon Pinnacle advises explorers to avoid.

entities.name: Sliver Weftwinder
entities.description: An apex sliver that can burrow beyond the tangible and hollow the Weft, living within the Chaos Wall.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's beloved cat, who disappeared.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: A kilometers-long horizon javelin vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: A solar system on the fringes of the known universe at the heart of a conflict between entropy and expansion.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The strip-mined Kav homeworld and its debris belt.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: A planet being terraformed by Eumidians that the Kav want to mine.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A gas giant where the Uthros Combine has a classified research station.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The Monoist monastery-world where Xu-Ifit is stationed.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: The Pinnacle station that Val hopes to attract.

entities.name: Garden of Apeiron
entities.description: A vast uncanny region at the edge of the system where the Inspirit drifts.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: A wall where Tezzeret was ejected and the Weftwinder makes its home.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Sunstar fighting order whose squires and knights arrive on the Dawnsire.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The faith that will do anything to prevent the supervoid's reignition.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: An Illvoi research outpost with a classified station in Uthros's atmosphere.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The Kav navy from which Tannuk was discharged.

entities.name: Kav Empire
entities.description: The empire Thendar steals from and whose colonists press Evendo.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The interstellar bureaucracy trying to keep the peace.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: The people who hunt Eldrazi using the Fabric of All Being.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The threat the Drix hunt.

entities.name: The Weft
entities.description: The layered fabric of reality weftwalked by Drix.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The place between planes from which Tezzeret was ejected.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which Tezzeret acquired freedom and a darksteel body.

events.summary: Following the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
events.quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.

events.summary: Tezzeret works to found a criminal consortium in the Edge.
events.quote: all while aiming to lay the foundations of a criminal consortium.

events.summary: After bad luck including Mirri's disappearance, Sami lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.
events.quote: After a run of bad luck (including the disappearance of their beloved cat, Mirri), they lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.

events.summary: Tannuk was dishonorably discharged from the KMN for redirecting a falling chunk of the debris belt.
events.quote: He was dishonorably discharged after redirecting a falling chunk of the Kavaron debris belt to minimize collateral damage, a crime among the disaster-prone remnants of the Kav homeworld.

events.summary: Exiled Tannuk joined Sami's crew and is now its last remaining member.
events.quote: Exiled from his people, Tannuk joined Sami and found the young captain to be as passionate about their crew as Tannuk was about his people.

events.summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
events.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

events.summary: Haliya pledged her bladiator to Syr Vondam's service.
events.quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

events.summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
events.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

events.summary: Alpharael has strange dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid.
events.quote: He has been plagued by strange dreams ever since his sister embraced eternity and dove into the supervoid.

events.summary: Mm'menon, expelled from the Uthros Combine, lent services to Tezzeret to stay in-system.
events.quote: After being expelled from the Combine, Mm'menon lent their services to Tezzeret to stay in-system

events.summary: Xu-Ifit's wife is frozen by time dilation after plunging into the supervoid.
events.quote: Ten years ago, Xu-Ifit's wife made the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid but was caught in a sudden gravitational anomaly, leaving her frozen in place by time dilation.

events.summary: Xu-Ifit experiments on Monoist acolytes to perfect a way to save her wife.
events.quote: she experiments on Monoist acolytes, testing their survivability through dangerous missions before sending them to take the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid.

events.summary: Abandoned on a moon, Dyadrine grafts local flora onto itself.
events.quote: After years of analysis, the mechan determined that local flora contained sufficient structural integrity from which to graft repairs onto themself.

events.summary: Kav colonists turn to Evendo for mining after wrecking Kavaron.
events.quote: Kav colonizers, having all but destroyed their homeworld of Kavaron, have turned their attention toward Evendo as a place to mine for natural resources.

events.summary: Szarel commits to the Evendo terrasymbiosis knowing he will not see it finished.
events.quote: Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion, but he has committed his life to advancing the cause.

events.summary: Kilo self-actualizes and takes a mechan body aboard the Inspirit in the Garden of Apeiron.
events.quote: Kilo has fully self-actualized, naming itself and moving the primary sliver of its consciousness to a single mechan body aboard its host vessel.

events.summary: Thendar is fired and deposited back on Kavaron That Is for skimming ore.
events.quote: Swiftly fired from his position and deposited back on Kavaron That Is

events.summary: Kav scrappers send Val's ship crashing onto an unexplored jungle world.
events.quote: Val has transmitted this message daily ever since a fateful run-in with Kav scrappers sent her ship hurtling to the surface of an unexplored jungle world.

events.summary: Axavar severs his contract as a Drix Eldrazi hunter.
events.quote: So Axavar severed his contract and his fate.

events.summary: Vv'viza takes over leadership of the Uthros Combine after Mm'menon's flight.
events.quote: Vv'viza eagerly stepped up to fill the void of leadership left in their absence.

events.summary: The Weftwinder emerges and makes its home within the Chaos Wall.
events.quote: Able to burrow beyond the tangible, to hollow the Weft as one might bore tunnels through earth, the Weftwinder has found its home within the Chaos Wall.

relations.quote: Together with their first mate, Tannuk, Sami is looking for the score that will restore their fortunes.

relations.quote: Emerging from the spacecraft's navigational mind, this intelligent consciousness developed its own subjectivity

relations.note: Szarel defends Evendo from Kav colonists.
relations.quote: he must manage the terrasymbiosis of the world while defending it from Kav colonists who attempt to claim it for themselves.

relations.note: Thendar has a grudge and steals from the empire.
relations.quote: Thendar has a grudge against the Kav Empire.
